subject.title: feat(onboard): recommendations store with once-semantics and self-naming bootstrap

question: Should identity-file persistence remain part of beat 2, or must it occur only after the recommendation offer has been answered so the existing workspace-completion rule cannot terminate the bootstrap early?
rationale: Both the desired self-naming sequence and the existing completion predicate are user-facing onboarding contracts; choosing whether to reorder the ceremony or change completion semantics requires owner intent.

options.title: Acknowledge before identity writes
options.body: Move the `IDENTITY.md` and `SOUL.md` persistence instructions after the recommendation response and `onboard recommendations acknowledge`, preserving the existing completion predicate.

options.title: Redefine bootstrap completion
options.body: Keep identity persistence in beat 2 but change the workspace completion contract so a pending recommendation offer prevents bootstrap deletion, with explicit migration and regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Acknowledge before identity writes
recommendation.body: Move the `IDENTITY.md` and `SOUL.md` persistence instructions after the recommendation response and `onboard recommendations acknowledge`, preserving the existing completion predicate.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch and its onboarding redesign rationale establish the intended ceremony and state semantics.
